priorityList: Cast Vampiric Touch on any targets as the pack is being grouped up
Cast Halo once all mobs are engaged in combat and within range
Use Tempered Potion unless saving for an upcoming pack or boss
Maintain Vampiric Touch and Shadow Word on up to 12 targets
Spend Insanity on Shadow Word by funneling into the highest health priority target
Cast Void Volley or Mind Blast to avoid losing their cooldowns
Cast Halo when it will not cause you to lose short-cooldown use
Cast Mind Flay when nothing higher priority is available
